ChatGPT.PluginDescription: Integrate ChatGPT AI assistant into Matomo for analytics insights and chat functionality.
ChatGPT.AskQuestion: Ask %s a question about this report
ChatGPT.HostDescription: Change the host to connect your own GPT instance
ChatGPT.ApiKeyDescription: Add your ChatGPT API Key here
ChatGPT.ModelPresetDescription: Select the model you want to use from the preset list.
ChatGPT.ModelCustomDescription: Specify a custom model name to override the preset selection. Leave empty to use the preset model.
ChatGPT.ModelPresetDescriptionMeasurable: Select the model you want to use. Leave empty to use system default.
ChatGPT.ModelCustomDescriptionMeasurable: Specify a custom model name to override the preset selection. Leave empty to use the preset or system default.
ChatGPT.ChatBasePromptDescription: Adapt the prompt to get more precise answers in the chat feature
ChatGPT.ChatBasePromptDefault: You are a Matomo expert and know everything about digital analytics. Your answer should be complete and precise.
ChatGPT.InsightBasePromptDescription: Adapt the prompt to get more precise insights for your reports
ChatGPT.InsightBasePromptDefault: Give me insights from the dataset formatted in JSON provided below, add bold style to most important metrics of your answer:
ChatGPT.RateLimitExceeded: Rate limit exceeded. Please wait %s seconds before making another request.
ChatGPT.ApiKeyNotConfigured: ChatGPT API key is not configured
ChatGPT.InvalidApiUrl: Invalid API host URL - HTTPS required
ChatGPT.PluginNotConfiguredDescription: Please configure the ChatGPT plugin in the general settings. For OpenAI, an API key is required. For custom hosts, only the host URL is needed.
